scope_summary: The user explicitly promoted the reviewed SX-VIS-063 terrain candidate, required current official research/implementation-feasibility/adversarial review for meaningful work, approved the SX-VIS-061 core-system board as a GitHub planning reference, approved SX-DEC-064 active-route lighting, and authorized the exact post-SX-DEC-064 Candidate 004 package validation. SX-DEC-064 adds only a procedural board projection rooted at actual train state: selected deterministic rails glow; alternate rails do not; lock is a separate overlay; terminal states do not predict future route. Candidate 004 records the exact existing product bytes, artifact/PCK integrity, fail-closed no-launch validation, and no physical/human evidence promotion. This approval does not authorize terrain runtime integration, a production asset family, gameplay/data/audio/locale/progression/Base changes, T2/Issue #227 work, PR #174 mutation, a solver, or human/player/release evidence promotion.
